description: This file defines the VLookup class, which implements the VLOOKUP function for spreadsheet calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for performing lookups with options for exact or approximate matches, sorting data, and searching through lookup arrays.

classes.name: VLookup
classes.description: Class implementing the VLOOKUP spreadsheet function, providing static methods for searching and retrieving data from lookup arrays.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a VLOOKUP operation on the provided lookup value within the lookup array, returning the corresponding value from specified column, with options for exact or approximate match.

methods.name: vlookupSort
methods.description: A private static method used to sort lookup array rows based on the first column, facilitating approximate matches.

methods.name: vLookupSearch
methods.description: A private static method to find the row number matching the lookup value within the lookup array, considering whether an exact match is required.
